title: Simple Food
description: Simple Food changes the look of food to a simple color.
body:
Simple Food Mod

Transform your Minecraft mealtime experience with Simple Food , a convenient mod that simplifies the visual representation of food items.

Description:
With Simple Food , you can enjoy a more streamlined look for all types of food in Minecraft. This mod replaces the intricate designs of various foods, making them appear as simple-colored squares or rectangles. The result is a cleaner and more minimalistic aesthetic that's sure to appeal to those who prefer a more straightforward experience.

Key Features:

Simplified Food Items: All types of food, including meats, fruits, vegetables, and other edible items, will be displayed in a consistent and easy-to-recognize format.
Color-Coded Design: Each type of food is represented by a simple square or rectangle with a corresponding color, making it easier to identify what you're eating.
No Compromise on Functionality: Don't worry – the functionality of your food items remains unchanged. You can still eat them, use them as fuel, and enjoy all their benefits.
Benefits:

Improved Visual Clarity: The clean design of Simple Food helps reduce visual clutter in your Minecraft world, making it easier to focus on the gameplay experience.
Enhanced Accessibility: This mod is particularly beneficial for players with visual impairments or those who prefer a more streamlined aesthetic.
Streamlined Experience: By simplifying food items, you can enjoy a more efficient and enjoyable gameplay experience.
Compatibility:

Minecraft Version: 1.8 - 1.19 (compatible with all Minecraft versions up to the latest)
Other Mods: Simple Food is designed to be compatible with most other mods, but please note that some conflicts may occur due to shared functionality or visual styles.
Installation:

To install Simple Food , follow these steps:

Download the mod from a reputable source (e.g., CurseForge).
Install Minecraft Forge on your PC.
Place the downloaded Simple Food jar file into the mods folder of your Minecraft directory.
Launch Minecraft and verify that the mod is working correctly.
Conclusion:
With Simple Food , you can enjoy a more straightforward and visually appealing gameplay experience in Minecraft. Try it out today and see how this simple yet effective mod enhances your overall game enjoyment!
